name: Tecnología Geek Loterías en Vivo
author: Erika Ramirez

sections.description:
Tecnología Geek Loterías en Vivo displays today’s results for the main Dominican Republic lotteries on any page of your WordPress site, with the balls, each draw’s date and the official logos. Results update automatically: your page never goes blank, because the plugin keeps the last good copy and keeps showing it if the feed fails.

Just paste the [tgloterias_en_vivo] shortcode and you are done. The [tgloterias_rd] shortcode works as an alias.

  • All 7 Dominican companies: Leidsa, Lotería Nacional, Loto Real, La Primera, Loteka, La Suerte and LoteDom (40+ draws), all visible and fully functional.
  • Automatic updates every 30 minutes, plus in-page refresh without reloading.
  • Responsive design for phones and tablets.
  • No accounts or API keys: install and use.
  • Reference results only: this plugin does not sell tickets and is not affiliated with any lottery company.

External services

This plugin connects to one external service only: the public results feed of Loterías Dominicanas (provider site: https://loteriasdominicanas.com/), served from the domain api.loteriasdominicanas.com.

  • What it is used for: downloading the catalog of companies and games and the day’s results, through GET requests to /dominicana/sites/env and /dominicana/sessions. The company and game logos that are part of that data load from the same service’s CDN (cdn.kiskoo.com); no other external resource is loaded in the frontend.
  • What data is sent: none about you, your visitors or your site. Requests carry only the plugin’s generic user agent. There is no telemetry, no user tracking and no accounts of any kind.
  • When it is queried: when the plugin is activated and periodically via WP-Cron (every 30 minutes), only to fetch results. If the service fails, the plugin displays the last saved copy of the results.
  • Terms of Service of the provider: https://loteriasdominicanas.com/pagina/terminos/
  • Privacy Policy of the provider: https://loteriasdominicanas.com/pagina/politica-de-privacidad/

En español: Este plugin se conecta a un único servicio externo: el feed público de resultados de Loterías Dominicanas (sitio del proveedor: https://loteriasdominicanas.com/), servido desde el dominio api.loteriasdominicanas.com. Se usa únicamente para descargar el catálogo de compañías y juegos y los resultados del día, mediante peticiones GET a /dominicana/sites/env y /dominicana/sessions. Los logos de compañías y juegos que forman parte de esos datos se cargan desde el CDN del mismo servicio (cdn.kiskoo.com); no se carga ningún otro recurso externo en el frontend. No se envía ningún dato sobre ti, tus visitantes o tu sitio: la petición solo viaja con el agente de usuario genérico del plugin. No hay telemetría, ni rastreo de usuarios, ni cuentas de ningún tipo. Se consulta al activar el plugin y periódicamente con WP-Cron (cada 30 minutos), únicamente para traer resultados; si el servicio falla, el plugin muestra la última copia de resultados guardada. Términos del servicio del proveedor: https://loteriasdominicanas.com/pagina/terminos/ — Política de privacidad del proveedor: https://loteriasdominicanas.com/pagina/politica-de-privacidad/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the tecnologia-geek-loterias-en-vivo folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install the plugin from the WordPress dashboard.
  2. Activate “Tecnología Geek Loterías en Vivo” in the Plugins menu.
  3. Paste the [tgloterias_en_vivo] shortcode on the page where you want the results.
sections.faq:
How often are the results updated?

Every 30 minutes, automatically. The block on the page also refreshes itself without reloading.

Which lotteries are included?

Leidsa, Lotería Nacional, Loto Real, La Primera, Loteka, La Suerte and LoteDom: all the companies of the Dominican feed, with all their draws.

Do I need an account or an API key?

No. The plugin works as soon as you activate it.

What happens if the results feed fails?

The plugin keeps the last good copy of the results and keeps displaying it; it also leaves a discreet notice in the admin for the administrator. Your page never goes blank.

Which shortcodes can I use?

[tgloterias_en_vivo] is the main shortcode; [tgloterias_rd] is accepted as an alias.

Which languages are available?

The plugin’s source strings are in English and the Spanish translation is provided through translate.wordpress.org language packs, so it follows your site’s language automatically.
sections.changelog:
2.1.0

  • Renamed to Tecnología Geek Loterías en Vivo, with the new slug tecnologia-geek-loterias-en-vivo (also the text domain).
  • Dominican Republic companies only, all fully visible and functional: the code that kept companies hidden was removed.
  • Shortcodes renamed to [tgloterias_en_vivo] and [tgloterias_rd]; all internal prefixes unified under tgloterias_.
  • Removed the bundled translation files (.po/.mo); translations are now delivered through translate.wordpress.org.
  • Removed the load_plugin_textdomain() call (no longer needed on WordPress.org).
  • Readme: documented the provider’s Terms of Service and Privacy Policy links in the External services section.

2.0.0

  • First public release as a product by Tecnología Geek.
  • Settings page under Settings → TG Loterías en Vivo with the feed status.
  • Hardened data source: persistent last-good copy, last-failure log and a discreet admin notice.
  • Feed URL filterable with tgloterias_feed_url.

1.0.0

  • Initial internal-use version: Dominican Republic results updating every 30 minutes.
